assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and guide appropriate anticoagulation therapy.
The service is performed via CPT 93271.
The diagnosis codes I48.91 and Z86.73 support the medical necessity of this service.
